blurb: Downtown Houston brings together picturesque reminders of Houston's rich heritage while simultaneously embracing the future.  This 3.5 hour food tour will explore Houston's diverse food scene in such places as neighboring warehouse district, north downtown Houston has a history as long as the city itself.  Houston's food scene has arrived and is worth visiting.
